name: Access Unpublished Linked Nodes
description: Rewrites in-body links to unpublished nodes so they carry an access_unpublished token, enabling end-to-end draft preview.
project_description:
The Access Unpublished Linked Nodes module is built to extend the Access Unpublished module functionality. We found that with Access Unpublished alone, our clients were adding auHash keyed links into draft body contents. This situation is driven by the desire of publishers to provide a sequence of drafts available for review using the initial auHash key value. Our clients use both Access Unpublished and add links to other content using Linkit from the ckeditor. We do not want any hash keys in any drafts saved to any revisions. Rather, we want the system to take care of providing the auHash key given that a valid auHash was provided at the onset of viewing the draft.

 Features 
 The Access Unpublished Linked Nodes module automatically prepares auHash keys for linked nodes in body contents.

Screenshot of it in action: current address= https://example.com/en/some-draft-example?auHash=fdas8f32few8f3vr98gdsa89gdsa8g9dsag 

 

 Post-Installation 
 Configure the module at /admin/config/content/access-unpublished-linked-nodes .

 Additional Requirements 
 access_unpublished and linkit 

 Supported modules/libraries 
 embed_block
